thread:
jess_sales: Quick sync for MerchantCo POC. Requirements: SAML SSO (Okta + Azure AD), SCIM with delta + one-time bulk import, group->role mapping (hierarchies preferred), delegated admin for HR, domain proofing for 5 subdomains, and predictable monthly pricing for provisioning. They also asked whether Redwood stores passwords or national IDs. Need a short buyer-facing blurb and a tech snippet on nested groups behavior.

li_engineering: Product note: SCIM 2.0 supported. Bulk import via API/UI for initial seed, then delta sync. Hosted default SCIM rate is 150 req/s with token-based smoothing; Dedicated can reserve workers and throughput for deterministic performance. For 2k/week ramp we recommend a temporary reserved throughput window or Dedicated.

jess_sales: They gave ramp numbers: week1 4k, week2 3k, then steady 600/day. Also asked about webhook callbacks for provisioning events.

anita_se: We support SCIM webhooks for provisioning events (user.created, user.updated, group.changed). Webhooks require a public endpoint or a proxy; customers can also poll an audit API. For nested groups: by default we flatten membership for RBAC to avoid hierarchical complexity. If they need ancestry we can include an ancestry array on groups via includeNested metadata, but that increases payload size. Recommend sample export if they use deep nesting.

omar_security: Security blurb for procurement: "Redwood does not store plaintext passwords or national IDs. SCIM attributes (email, name, externalId, group membership) are encrypted at rest (AES-256-GCM) and in transit (TLS1.2+). For Dedicated or Private deployments we support customer-managed KMS (AWS KMS / GCP CMEK) and HSM options. Provisioning events are logged and available for audit; we can redact optional PII on request."

jess_sales: Buyer-facing 2-line blurb please.

anita_se: Buyer blurb: "Redwood supports SAML 2.0 (SP and IdP flows), SCIM 2.0 with bulk import and delta sync, and Okta/Azure group-to-role mappings. For predictable onboarding windows we recommend Redwood Dedicated (reserved throughput) or Hosted with a provisioning quota add-on; we never store plaintext passwords or national IDs and offer customer-managed KMS for higher compliance needs."

li_engineering: Billing model quick: base provisioning tier covers up to a band of active users + per-active-user pricing beyond that. Large ramps can add a temporary reserved-throughput fee or opt for Dedicated capacity. Example guidance: 18k total users typically maps to our 10k-25k band; include a 3-week ramp add-on for heavy onboarding. I'll fetch concrete pricing from finance.

jess_sales: They also asked about delegated admin: can HR create users but not change org-wide settings?

anita_se: Yes. We support delegated admin roles scoped to tenant-level provisioning actions. You can grant HR a role that can create/update users and groups but not alter tenancy billing or config. Roles are mappable from IdP groups or created in the console.

omar_security: Operational note: ask MerchantCo to provide (1) sample SCIM export, (2) exact ramp schedule and time windows, (3) webhook endpoint or proxy details, (4) DNS access or domain admin email for TXT verification. Potential blocker: if they require on-prem-only HSM with air-gapped key exchange that will force Private deployment planning.

jess_sales: Tech YAML snippet for the SOW I can paste:

```yaml
provisioning:
  protocol: "SCIM 2.0"
  bulk_import: true
  delta_sync: true
  unique_key: "externalId | userName"
  group_mapping: "idp.group -> app.role (flattened by default, ancestry optional via includeNested)"
  hosted_default_rate: "150req/s (burst smoothing)"
  dedicated: "reserved workers + throughput (SLA option)"
webhooks:
  supported_events: ["user.created","user.updated","group.changed"]
  note: "requires public endpoint or proxy + IP whitelist"
security:
  transport: "TLS1.2+"
  at_rest: "AES-256-GCM"
  kms: "customer-managed optional (AWS KMS / GCP CMEK)"
  pii_handling: "no plaintext passwords or national IDs; optional fields can be redacted"
```

jess_sales: Great. I'll send this plus Omar's security note and request the sample SCIM export. Omar, can you start the vendor questionnaire?

omar_security: On it. I will flag any high-risk asks. Expect a first draft in 36h. :thumbsup:
